Integrates with the Foam Hunter Scoring app. Choose a target as you shoot and save it for reference later. 

Also includes complete copies of the *official* ASA and IBO rulebooks.

Features
- Displays scoring rings for the most popular 3D foam animal targets from Delta McKenzie (ASA) and Rinehart (IBO)
- Searchable database of 70 targets with more added regularly
- Search by name ("Deer", "Antelope") as well as characteristics ("antlers", "white")
- Zoom and pan to view target details
- Arrow placement clearly marked and easier to see than cards
- More cost effective than physical cards
- Complete copies of the *official* ASA and IBO rulebooks.

"Tennis Record" is score and stats management tool for all tennis players and coaches.

Easily can record score, and create stats and summary that are useful to analyze your plays.

Can write match summary and player stats to PDF, can share it using shared link of Dropbox, email, or open in other app.


◉Match Rules
-Support soft tennis
-Singles and doubles
-Support "Tie-break"
-Anytime can record tie-break game when the score is tie
-Support "No Advantage"
-The number of sets is upper limit to 5
-The number of games is No limit and anytime can finish the set
-Support walkover and retirement


◉Match Score Recording
-Service Result (In, Ace, Winner, Out, Net, Foot Fault, Penalty)
-Service Placement
-Last Shot (Winner, Good Shot instead of forced error, Unforced Error)
-Shot Type (FH Stroke, BH Stroke, FH Volley, BH Volley, Smash)
-Stroke Type (Flat, Topspin, Slice, Drop Shot, Lob Shot)
-Stroke Position and Placement
-Unforced Error Type (Long, Wide, Net)
-Rally Length


◉Player Stats
-Can search stats under various condition (term, competition, surface, opponent)


◉Other
-Support multi tasking on iPad
-Support landscape mode (iPad only)
-Can add players without limit
-Four types of court surface image
-Player appears as photo image or customized wear icon
-Data backup to cloud storage (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, etc.)

CCR Builder is an interactive assembly checklist for Closed Circuit Rebreathers (CCRs). No more paper checklists, calculators, or spreadsheets, CCR Builder is right on your phone ready when you need it. It's fast and intuitive to use and handles all the calculations for you on the fly. Currently supporting the KISS Sidewinder CCR, with more on the way.
